info.name: Merchant KYC Onboarding API
info.description: All data is fictional. Start the server (npm run dev), set the callbackSecret variable to the KYC_CALLBACK_SECRET value from your own .env, then run the folders in order (Collection Runner). Folder 0 logs in and stores the tokens, which last 1 hour.
